name: flow_duel_the_caretaker_after_the_offer
description: Duel the caretaker after the queue's 60 s offer (M7, design 1.5, 5.2; contract-m7 §4): a duellist alone, queued for a rival with nobody coming; before the minute only Cancel; at 1:00 NOTICE caretakers_offered says 'The caretaker can be your rival', and the one button becomes Duel the caretaker with 'Cancel · 1:00' beside its line. It sends QUEUE start_with_caretakers, and the party's own match forms at once: my seat on team 0 against 'Caretaker 1', a caretaker of my own Builder on team 1 (MATCH_CONFIG's caretaker flag, gone at the barrier). The game seats it as a caretaker and the simulation's caretaker plays it from tick 0, on Undertow's own preset; Play again leaves the party forming, not queued again (it was the party's own match).

steps.msg: this build has the duel's rules

steps.assert: Session.last_notice == 'The caretaker can be your rival'
steps.msg: NOTICE caretakers_offered, in the duel's words

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').primary_text() == 'Duel the caretaker' and not node('Primary').disabled
steps.msg: the one button duels the caretaker

steps.assert: seats.size() == 2 and seats[0]['team'] == 0 and seats[0]['name'] == 'Sascha' and seats[0]['flags'] == 0 and seats[0]['builder'] == 1
steps.msg: my seat on team 0, my Lookout

steps.assert: seats[1]['team'] == 1 and seats[1]['name'] == 'Caretaker 1' and seats[1]['flags'] == 1 and seats[1]['builder'] == 1
steps.msg: the rival: one caretaker Lookout on team 1
the party's own match, its rival a caretaker: Play again will not queue it
the simulation's caretaker plays the rival from tick 0, on Undertow's own rules

steps.assert: Session.state_name() == 'HUB' and node('HubPanel').primary_text() == 'Find a rival' and Session.get_node('LoopbackHub').seq.queue_log == ['enter', 'start_with_caretakers']
steps.msg: back to the party, forming: a start with the caretaker is not queued again
